---
title: "R Packages"
description: "Reference documentation and vignettes for ten actively maintained R packages covering regression diagnostics, customer segmentation, descriptive statistics and inference."
---

Ten packages, all on CRAN, all documented. Each card links to the package's
reference site, its CRAN page and its source.

## Regression and modelling

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-olsrr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the olsrr R package"}

### olsrr {.card-title}

Tools for building OLS regression models. Coefficient diagnostics, ANOVA
tables, influential observation analysis and model comparison.

[Reference](https://olsrr.rsquaredacademy.com) ·
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=olsrr) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/olsrr)
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-blorr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the blorr R package"}

### blorr {.card-title}

Tools for developing binary logistic regression models, with comprehensive
regression output, model fit statistics and validation measures.

[Reference](https://blorr.rsquaredacademy.com) ·
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=blorr) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/blorr)
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-xplorerr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the xplorerr R package"}

### xplorerr {.card-title}

Interactive data exploration and visualization: correlation heatmaps,
scatterplots, distribution checks and regression modelling from a
point-and-click interface.

[Reference](https://xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com) ·
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=xplorerr) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/xplorerr)
:::
:::

## Descriptive and inferential statistics

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-descriptr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the descriptr R package"}

### descriptr {.card-title}

Descriptive statistics and frequency tables for numeric and categorical data.
Skewness, kurtosis and key statistics, computed fast.

[Reference](https://descriptr.rsquaredacademy.com) ·
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=descriptr) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/descriptr)
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-inferr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the inferr R package"}

### inferr {.card-title}

Hypothesis testing and inference. Parametric and non-parametric tests with
structured, readable output: t-test, chi-square, ANOVA and correlation.

[Reference](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com) ·
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=inferr) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/inferr)
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-vistributions.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the vistributions R package"}

### vistributions {.card-title}

Visualize probability distributions of univariate data across continuous and
discrete families, with statistical quality checks.

[Reference](https://vistributions.rsquaredacademy.com) ·
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=vistributions) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/vistributions)
:::
:::

## Data wrangling

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-rbin.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the rbin R package"}

### rbin {.card-title}

Bin and group numeric data into intervals: equidistant, quantile and custom
breaks, with an interactive mode for picking them.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=rbin) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/rbin)
:::
:::

## Archived

::: {.callout-warning}
### nse2r — archived, under revival

`nse2r` fetched live data from the National Stock Exchange of India. It was
**archived on CRAN on 2023-08-07** at the maintainer's request and is currently
being revived, so it is no longer installable from CRAN.

Source and issue tracker:
[github.com/rsquaredacademy/nse2r](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/nse2r).
:::
